title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income

title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
